chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan di prophet come to am, after e don go to Bathsheba.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your faithful love. According to di plenty of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
Because I know my transgressions. My sin dey always before me.
Against you, you only, I don sin and do wetin bad for your sight, so dat you go dey right when you talk and clear when you judge.
Look, dem born me for iniquity. My mama conceive me for sin.
Look, you desire truth for di inward parts. You go make me know wisdom for di inmost place.
Purify me with hyssop, and I go clean. Wash me, and I go whiter pass snow.
Make me hear joy and gladness, so dat di bones wey you don break go rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
Create clean heart for me, God. Renew steadfast spirit inside me.
No throw me away from your presence, and no take your Holy Spirit from me.
Restore to me di joy of your salvation. Uphold me with willing spirit.
Den I go teach transgressors your ways, and sinners go turn to you.
Deliver me from bloodguilt, God, di God of my salvation, and my tongue go sing aloud of your righteousness.
Lord, open my lips, and my mouth go declare your praise.
Because you no delight for sacrifice, or else I go give am. You no take pleasure for burnt offering.
Di sacrifices of God na broken spirit. God, you no go despise broken and contrite heart.
Do good for Zion for your good pleasure. Build di walls of Jerusalem.
Den you go delight for di sacrifices of righteousness, for burnt offering and whole burnt offering. Den dem go offer bulls on your altar.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg di Edomite come and tell Saul say, “David don come to Ahimelech house.”

verses.text: Why you dey boast for evil, you mighty man? Di faithful love of God dey all di day.
Your tongue dey plot destruction, like sharp razor, working deceitfully.
You love evil more pass good, and lying more pass speaking righteousness. Selah.
You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
But God go also bring you down forever. E go snatch you up and pull you out of your tent and uproot you from di land of di living. Selah.
Di righteous go also see am and fear, and go laugh at am say,
“See di man wey no make God im stronghold, but trust for di abundance of im riches and make imself strong for im wickedness.”
But as for me, I be like green olive tree for God house. I trust for di faithful love of God forever and ever.
I go thank you forever, because you don do am. I go wait for your name, because e good, for di presence of your holy ones.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Mahalath. A contemplation by David.

verses.text: Di fool don talk for im heart say, “No God dey.” Dem dey corrupt and dem don do abominable iniquity. Nobody dey wey dey do good.
God look down from heaven on di pikin dem of men, to see if anybody dey wey get understanding, wey dey seek God.
Every one don turn away. Dem don become corrupt together. Nobody dey wey dey do good, no, not even one.
Dem wey dey do iniquity no get knowledge? Dem dey eat up my people as dem dey eat bread. Dem no dey call on God.
Dere dem dey for great terror, where no terror dey, because God don scatter di bones of am wey camp against you. You don put dem to shame, because God don reject dem.
Oh make Israel salvation come out of Zion! When God bring back im people from captivity, Jacob go rejoice and Israel go be glad.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when di Ziphites come and talk to Saul say, “David no dey hide with us?”

verses.text: Save me, God, by your name. Defend me by your might.
Hear my prayer, God. Listen to di words of my mouth.
Because strangers don rise up against me. Violent men dey seek my soul. Dem no set God before dem. Selah.
Look, God na my helper. Di Lord dey among dem wey uphold my soul.
E go repay evil to my enemies. Destroy dem for your truth.
With free will offering I go sacrifice to you. I go give thanks to your name, Lord, because e good.
Because e don deliver me out of all trouble, and my eye don see im desire on my enemies.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A contemplation by David.

verses.text: Give ear to my prayer, God. No hide yourself from my begging.
Attend to me and answer me. I dey restless for my complaint and dey moan,
because of di voice of di enemy, because of di oppression of di wicked. Because dem dey bring trouble on me, and for anger dem dey hate me.
My heart dey for anguish inside me. Terrors of death don fall on me.
Fear and trembling don come on me. Horror don overwhelm me.
I talk say, “Oh, if I get wings like dove! Den I go fly away and rest.
Look, I go wander far away. I go stay for di wilderness. Selah.
I go hurry go my shelter from di stormy wind and tempest.”
Confuse dem, Lord, and divide dem tongues, because I don see violence and strife for di city.
Day and night dem dey go round am on im walls. Iniquity and trouble dey inside am.
Destruction dey inside am. Oppression and fraud no dey leave im streets.
Because no be enemy dey mock me, because I fit bear am. No be one wey hate me dey rise up against me, because I fit hide from am.
But na you, man wey be my equal, my companion and my close friend.
We enjoy sweet fellowship together. We waka to God house for di crowd.
Make death come on dem. Make dem go down alive to Sheol, because wickedness dey for dem dwelling, among dem.
As for me, I go call on God, and di Lord go save me.
Evening, morning and noon I go complain and moan, and e go hear my voice.
E don redeem my soul in peace from di battle wey dey against me, because dem plenty wey dey against me.
God go hear and answer dem, di one wey don sit from of old. Selah. Dem no change, and dem no fear God.
E don stretch out im hands against dem wey dey at peace with am. E don break im covenant.
Im mouth smooth like butter, but war dey im heart. Im words soft pass oil, yet dem be like drawn swords.
Cast your burden on di Lord, and e go sustain you. E no go ever allow di righteous to be moved.
But you, God, go bring dem down into di pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men no go live half dem days, but I go trust you.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Di Silent Dove for Far Away Places. By David. A miktam, when di Philistines catch am for Gath.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, God, because man wan swallow me up. All day long dem dey fight and oppress me.
My enemies wan swallow me up all day long, because plenty dey fight against me proudly.
When I dey afraid, I go trust you.
For God, whose word I praise, for God I don put my trust. I no go fear. Wetin flesh fit do to me?
All day dem dey twist my words. All dem thoughts na against me for evil.
Dem dey gather together. Dem dey hide. Dem dey watch my steps, as dem dey wait for my soul.
Dem go escape because of iniquity? For anger, God, bring down di peoples.
You don count my wandering. Put my tears for your bottle. Dem no dey for your book?
Den my enemies go turn back for di day wey I call. Dis I know, say God dey for me.
For God, whose word I praise, for di Lord, whose word I praise,
for God I don put my trust. I no go fear. Wetin man fit do to me?
Your vows dey on me, God. I go render thank offerings to you.
Because you don deliver my soul from death. You no don keep my feet from falling, so dat I go waka before God for di light of life?

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Do Not Destroy. By David. A miktam, when e run from Saul, inside di cave.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, God. Have mercy on me, because my soul dey take refuge for you. Yes, for di shadow of your wings I go take refuge, until destruction pass.
I go cry out to God Most High, to God wey dey accomplish all things for me.
E go send from heaven and save me, when di one wey wan swallow me up dey taunt. Selah. God go send out im faithful love and im truth.
My soul dey among lions. I dey lie among men wey dey breathe fire, men wey im teeth na spears and arrows, and im tongue na sharp sword.
Be exalted, God, above di heavens. Make your glory dey above all di earth.
Dem prepare net for my steps. My soul bow down. Dem dig pit before me. Dem don fall inside am dem self. Selah.
My heart dey steadfast, God. My heart dey steadfast. I go sing, yes, I go sing praises.
Wake up, my glory! Wake up, harp and lyre! I go wake di dawn.
I go give thanks to you, Lord, among di peoples. I go sing praises to you among di nations.
Because your faithful love dey great to di heavens, and your truth to di skies.
Be exalted, God, above di heavens. Make your glory dey above all di earth.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Do Not Destroy. By David. A miktam.

verses.text: You rulers, you dey really speak righteousness? You dey judge di pikin dem of men with fairness?
No, for heart you dey work wickedness. For di earth, your hands dey weigh out violence.
Di wicked dey go astray from di womb. Dem dey go astray from birth, wey dey speak lies.
Dem poison be like di poison of snake. Dem be like deaf cobra wey close im ear,
wey no go hear di voice of snake charmers, no matter how skillful di charmer.
Break dem teeth, God, for dem mouth. Break out di fangs of di young lions, Lord.
Make dem melt away like water wey dey run. When dem aim dem arrows, make dem be like dem cut off.
Make dem be like snail wey melt away as e dey move, like untimely birth wey no see di sun.
Before your pots fit feel di thorns, e go sweep dem away with whirlwind, di green and di burning alike.
Di righteous go rejoice when e see di vengeance. E go wash im feet for di blood of di wicked.
Men go talk say, “Sure sure reward dey for di righteous. Sure sure God dey wey dey judge for di earth.”

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Do Not Destroy. By David. A miktam, when Saul send men and dem watch im house to kill am.

verses.text: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Protect me from dem wey rise up against me.
Deliver me from di workers of iniquity. Save me from bloodthirsty men.
Because look, dem dey lie in wait for my soul. Fierce men dey gather against me, no be because of my disobedience or my sin, Lord.
I no do wrong, yet dem dey run and ready dem self. Wake up to help me and see.
You, Lord God of Armies, di God of Israel, rise up to punish all di nations. No show mercy to any wicked traitors. Selah.
Dem dey return for evening. Dem dey growl like dog and dey go round di city.
Look, dem dey belch with dem mouth. Swords dey dem lips, because dem dey talk say, “Who dey hear us?”
But you, Lord, go laugh at dem. You go mock all di nations.
Because of im strength, I go wait for you, because God na my high tower.
My God with im faithful love go meet me. God go let me look on my enemies.
No kill dem, or my people go forget. Scatter dem by your power and bring dem down, Lord our shield.
For di sin of dem mouth and di words of dem lips, make dem dey caught for dem pride, for di curses and lies wey dem dey speak.
Consume dem for wrath. Consume dem, so dat dem no go dey again. Make dem know say God dey rule for Jacob, to di ends of di earth. Selah.
Dem dey return for evening. Dem dey growl like dog and dey go round di city.
Dem dey wander up and down for food and growl if dem no satisfy.
But I go sing of your strength. Yes, I go sing aloud of your faithful love for morning, because you don be my high tower and refuge for di day of my trouble.
To you, my strength, I go sing praises, because God na my high tower, di God of my faithful love.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Lily of di Covenant. A miktam by David, to teach, when e fight Aram Naharaim and Aram Zobah, and Joab return and kill 12,000 Edomites for di Valley of Salt.

verses.text: God, you don reject us. You don break us. You don dey angry. Oh restore us.
You don make di earth tremble. You don tear am open. Heal im breaks, because e dey shake.
You don show your people hard things. You don make us drink wine wey dey make us stagger.
You don give banner to dem wey fear you, so dat e go dey lifted up because of truth. Selah.
So dat your beloved ones go dey delivered, save us with your right hand and answer us.
God don talk for im holiness: “I go rejoice. I go divide Shechem and measure out di valley of Succoth.
Gilead na my own, and Manasseh na my own. Ephraim na di helmet of my head. Judah na my scepter.
Moab na my wash basin. Over Edom I go throw my shoe. Philistia, shout over me.”
Who go bring me inside di strong city? Who don lead me to Edom?
You no be God, wey don reject us? You no dey go out with our armies, God.
Give us help against di enemy, because human help no get value.
Through God we go do valiantly, because na im go tread down our enemies.
